_doc: crm-ui-guard allowlist. Entries suppress ONE rule in ONE file with a reason. Prefer fixing over listing. Never list Store paths (apps/ecommerce is out of guard scope by design). Entry shape: { file (repo-relative, exact), rule (RULE_ID or '*'), reason }.

Stage color default is persisted data, not a styling literal: the field is user-editable text, consumed as a Tailwind class by the pipeline board and as a raw hex (with alpha suffixes) by the kanban and table views. Constraining it to a token vocabulary is a data-contract change, tracked as deferred item 25
